card.name: Cerebrospinal fluid word start
card.fires_on: The first pieces of 'cerebrospinal' (cere, bro) right before 'fluid', mostly in 'aspirate for blood or cerebrospinal fluid'. Also 'clear' before 'liquids'.

modes.label: Cerebrospinal opening
modes.description: The start of 'cerebrospinal' after 'blood or' in aspiration instructions, just before 'fluid'.

card.writes: It does not push liquid words itself; it suppresses 'liquid' and 'fluid' tokens, probably because the next word is already predictable.
card.plain: It fires on the start of 'cerebrospinal' or 'clear' when the next word will be 'fluid' or 'liquids'.
